value.rationale: The complete Hasse-Weil zeta of a natural representation fourfold records the number of group homomorphisms into B(F_{q^r}) in every extension, and exhibits a nontrivial gcd-sensitive splitting pattern of 16m exceptional points. This answers an exact natural arithmetic invariant for an unbounded family rather than an arbitrary finite slice. The computation is elementary but the all-prime, all-extension uniform count goes beyond complex topological invariants.
